newsitem.title: USA: Anadarko sees production doubling in 4 yrs.
newsitem.headline: Anadarko sees production doubling in 4 yrs.

text.p: Anadarko Petroleum Corp on Wednesday said it expects to double its production volumes over the next four years by developing previously reported exploration discoveries.

"In the 10 years since Anadarko became an independent company, we've doubled production -- and in the next four years we expect to double it again," said Robert J. Allison, Jr., chairman, president and chief executive officer. Stated on
an energy equivalent barrel basis, combined production of crude oil and natural gas is estimated to rise from 38 million barrels in 1996 to 76 million barrels in 2000, Anadarko said.

Allison said the largest area of increase will be crude oil production from Algeria which is expected to grow from 60,000 barrels of oil per day (bpd) gross in early 1998 to 300,000 bpd gross by 2000.
The increase in production volumes includes no new discoveries, the company said.
